_readme: Manifest of course illustrations. One entry per lesson: {caption, alt}. The image file must exist at assets/img/<lessonId>.png and is 1280x896. Captions stay in the lesson's own language and describe what the illustration shows. Numbers are only ever dictated explicitly; where a lesson carries no numeric limits the illustration is deliberately symbolic.
